subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: Everybody wants success in life (a) ----- everybody can't achieve it. In our society, there are people (b) ----- get frustrated. (c) ----- success does not come very easily at first attempt. (d) -----, if you want to achieve true success in life, you must have some qualities such as sincerity and honesty. (e) -----, you need to have perseverance and patience.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors: (a) but; (b) who; (c) Because; (d) Actually; (e) In addition.
